question.text: Mr. Suresh Reddy, a resident Indian individual, wants to invest in an offshore AIF via the RBI's Liberalised Remittance Scheme (LRS). What is the current annual LRS limit per person per financial year?

explanation.text: The Logic: RBI's Liberalised Remittance Scheme (LRS) allows Indian residents to remit abroad up to USD 2,50,000 per person per financial year for permissible current or capital account transactions. The Trap: USD 1 lakh, USD 5 lakh and USD 10 lakh are not the current LRS limit. Note: The workbook supports the USD 2,50,000 LRS limit per person per financial year. Older-limit history, offshore-fund inclusion specifics, quarterly FX tranching, and client-planning commentary have been removed as they are not directly supported by the checked page.
